result:
Perfect! I've fixed the permission issue. The `dist/` and `uploads/` directories now have full write permissions for all users using Windows ACLs.

**What was wrong:**
- These directories had restrictive permissions that prevented other users/processes from writing to them
- When the CI built into `dist/` or the web tier wrote into `uploads/`, it would fail with EACCES (permission denied)

**What I fixed:**
- Granted full permissions (`F`) to `Everyone` on both directories
- Applied inheritance flags so new files/subdirectories created in these directories will also be writable

The deploy should now succeed without EACCES errors.
